analysis.reason: RSI 61.9로 과매수 구간에서 하락 시작, MACD 히스토그램 개선세 약화. 5일 연속 변동률은 +1.34%로 상승 마감했으나, 4일 전 -7.65% 급락 후 반등 강도 미약. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.44로 위축. 현재가 $0.10은 스윙 저항선과 일치하며, 52주 고가 대비 14.9% 수준으로 여전히 낮은 위치. 주봉 RSI 53.1, ADX 33.5로 추세는 뚜렷하나 일봉상 추가 상승 동력 부족.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 61.9 shows cooling from overbought territory, and MACD histogram improvement is weak. While the 5-day price change was +1.34%, the rebound after a -7.65% drop 4 days ago lacks strength. Volume is also subdued at 0.44 times the 5-day average. The current price of $0.10 aligns with the swing resistance and remains low at 14.9% of the 52-week high. Weekly RSI is 53.1 and ADX is 33.5, indicating a clear trend, but daily momentum for further upside is insufficient.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.10) vs SMA5 ($0.10)/SMA20 ($0.09)/SMA50 ($0.08): Facing resistance in the short-term trend, above the mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($0.08)/SMA200 ($0.09): Above the long-term trend, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (14.9%) + Current price level is a recovery phase from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (71.1→61.9): Cooling from overbought territory, nearing neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0013→0.0010): Weakening improvement, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $0.10): At the upper resistance zone, with a band width of 30.22% expanding.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.09): Based on SMA20, EMA20, Pivot PP.
· Swing resistance ($0.10): Aligns with current price, expecting upward momentum upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Trading sideways within the range of 5-day high $0.10 and 20-day high $0.11, Higher Low pattern not confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.44x): Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of the move.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, requires confirmation of further upside momentum, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
